# xshield_assets (Data Source)

Assets matching a criteria, with the enforcement state of each.

Note that the asset search always excludes user groups and applies the caller's own access constraint, so the criteria the server evaluates is narrower than the one sent.

`attack_surface` and `blast_radius` are risk scores rather than enforcement state; the fields here that describe enforcement are the deployment states, the policy modes and the statuses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every production payroll asset, with its enforcement state.
data "xshield_assets" "payroll" {
  criteria = "application = 'payroll' AND environment = 'prod'"
}

# Assets that cannot take a per-port deployment, which a deployment plan must avoid.
output "whole_asset_only" {
  value = [
    for a in data.xshield_assets.payroll.assets : a.asset_name
    if !a.micro_deployment_compatible
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the assets, written against the asset scope.

### Optional

- `max_results` (Number) Stop after this many results. Left unset, every match is read. When a limit truncates the result set, `truncated` is true.

### Read-Only

- `assets` (Attributes List) The matching assets, ordered by name with the id as a tie-break. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assets))
- `ids` (List of String) Ids of the matching assets, in the same order as the detailed list. Convenient for `for_each`.
- `total` (Number) Total number of assets matching the criteria, as reported by the API.
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when `max_results` stopped the read before the end of the result set.

<a id="nestedatt--assets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assets`

Read-Only:

- `agent_status` (String) Agent state. An asset with no agent cannot have policy enforced.
- `asset_name` (String) Asset name, which is not guaranteed unique.
- `core_tags` (Map of String) Core tag values, the fields a segment criteria may select on.
- `id` (String) Immutable asset id.
- `inbound_asset_deployment_state` (String) Whether inbound enforcement is enabled or disabled.
- `inbound_asset_policy_mode` (String) Whether inbound policy is not deployed, under test or enforced.
- `inbound_asset_status` (String) Derived inbound posture, from unsecured through to secure.
- `managed_by` (String) Which system manages the asset, for example colortokens or an EDR vendor.
- `micro_deployment_compatible` (Boolean) Whether the asset accepts a per-port deployment rather than only a whole-asset one.
- `os_name` (String)
- `outbound_asset_deployment_state` (String) Whether outbound enforcement is enabled or disabled.
- `outbound_asset_policy_mode` (String) Whether outbound policy is not deployed, under test or enforced.
- `outbound_asset_status` (String) Derived outbound posture.
- `pending_attack_surface_changes` (Boolean) True when inbound intent has changed but has not been deployed.
- `pending_blast_radius_changes` (Boolean) True when outbound intent has changed but has not been deployed.
- `platform` (String)
- `total_ports` (Number)
- `type` (String) Asset type, such as server or endpoint.
- `unreviewed_ports` (Number) Listening ports with no review decision yet.
